title: Aarhus BSS Graduate School PhD general call (February 2027)
institution: Aarhus University, Aarhus BSS Graduate School
about: General call for PhD positions in business and social sciences across six PhD programmes at Aarhus BSS Graduate School, Aarhus University. Applications open 4 January and close 1 February 2027; earliest start 1 September 2027, with decisions expected by end of April 2027.
